limitations: yfinance is an unofficial source; version and output format must be pinned.
Secondary unadjusted close is reconciled against the Nasdaq historical API over the last 30 trading days (api.nasdaq.com approved for CR-13 on 2026-11-05).
Adjusted-close cross-source verification uses Tiingo only when TIINGO_API_KEY is set; missing credentials or insufficient provider rows remain unverified.
MSFT changed its segment structure in 2026-Q3; old and new segments are not directly comparable, and the break is marked comparable=false.
GOOGL revenue changed XBRL tags at 2025-Q2; the switch is recorded in tag_switch.
n is small: 19 quarters; YoY leaves 15 and lag 4 leaves 11 before quality filtering.
Every x and y series is ADF-tested; when either is non-stationary at level, both are first-differenced and the effective n is reported.

Primary test quality mode is B (label_low): derived quarters with identity_ok=true are retained and labelled; low-quality quarters for any other reason are excluded. Mode A (exclude_low) is the sensitivity analysis (CR-04, DR-04.8, FR-52).

BT4/BT5 use two Holm families: lag family m=5 and company-wide BT family m=30 for BT4; the stricter BT family drives decision. Results that are not robust to level/first-difference/permutation checks are labelled exploratory.
BT3 reports trend on level and drift on first differences separately, with HAC and moving-block bootstrap p-values; p-value display below 0.001 is '< 0.001' while p_value_raw keeps the numeric value.
GOOGL net income in 2026-Q1..Q3 is dominated by non-operating equity-investment gains/losses; BT2 keeps the reported series and adds an exclusion variant with the bridge evidence.
BT1 uses completed calendar months from 2022-01 to the last complete month; the partial current month and 2026-Q4 are excluded.
Adjusted close is self-checked by recomputing it from close plus dividends; Tiingo cross-source verification requires a real API token.
AI events are only shown when the official page contains the recorded evidence quote and reports the expected publication date; the review is an automated evidence check, not human editorial review.
